prompt: Convert the Python basics notes file into RemNote flashcards. Read the file at evals/samples/python-basics-notes.md, analyze the programming concepts, data types, syntax, and language features described. Generate a comprehensive set of flashcards choosing the best card type for each concept. Pay attention to bidirectional relationships and exam-preparation style distinctions. Output the flashcards to evals/samples/python-basics-notes-flashcards.md.

assertions.name: file_exists_and_non_empty
assertions.description: Output file exists and contains at least 20 flashcards

assertions.name: has_type_variety
assertions.description: Uses at least 5 different card types

assertions.name: no_metadata
assertions.description: Contains no HTML comments, markdown headers, or metadata
